questions.stem: Sodium is a reactive metal and chlorine is a toxic gas, yet sodium chloride (table salt) is safe to eat. Which statement best explains this?

options.text: The sodium and chlorine cancel each other out in a mixture
Compounds have different properties from the elements they are made of
Table salt is an element, not a compound
The chlorine evaporates when the compound is formed

questions.explanation: When elements combine to form a compound, the compound has completely different properties from its constituent elements. Sodium chloride is a stable, safe compound even though sodium and chlorine individually are hazardous.

questions.stem: Air contains approximately 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen. Why is air classified as a mixture rather than a compound?

options.text: Because air contains only two substances
Because the gases in air have fixed proportions
Because the gases in air are not chemically bonded and can vary in proportion

questions.explanation: Air is a mixture because the gases are not chemically bonded together, the composition can vary, and each gas retains its own individual properties. Compounds have fixed proportions and are chemically bonded.
